commands: set -euo pipefail; echo '=== INSTALL PINNED PNPM ==='; PREFIX="$(npm config get prefix)"; echo "npm_prefix=$PREFIX"; npm install --global pnpm@11.10.0; command -v pnpm; test "$(pnpm --version)" = "11.10.0"; echo 'PNPM_READY'

set -euo pipefail; echo '=== ESP-IDF DIAGNOSTIC ==='; IDF="$HOME/esp/esp-idf"; test -d "$IDF/.git"; git -C "$IDF" rev-parse --short HEAD; git -C "$IDF" describe --tags --always --dirty; set +e; source "$IDF/export.sh"; RC=$?; set -e; echo "export_rc=$RC"; echo "IDF_PATH=${IDF_PATH:-}"; command -v idf.py || true; if command -v idf.py >/dev/null 2>&1; then idf.py --version; fi; if [ "$RC" -ne 0 ] || ! command -v idf.py >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo '=== FALLBACK IDF 5.5.4 ==='; IDF="$HOME/esp/esp-idf-v5.5.4"; test -f "$IDF/export.sh"; source "$IDF/export.sh"; command -v idf.py; idf.py --version; fi; echo 'IDF_DIAGNOSTIC_OK'
